name: CRM · Pipeline by Stage
sql:
SELECT o.stage,
       COUNT(*)                                   AS opportunity_count,
       ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2)                    AS pipeline_value,
       ROUND(SUM(o.amount * o.probability / 100.0), 2) AS weighted_value,
       ROUND(AVG(o.amount), 2)                    AS avg_deal_size
FROM opportunities o
GROUP BY o.stage
ORDER BY pipeline_value DESC

name: CRM · Monthly Bookings Trend
sql:
SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS order_month,
       COUNT(*)                        AS order_count,
       ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2)   AS booked_value,
       ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2)   AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status IN ('Confirmed', 'Fulfilled')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
ORDER BY order_month

name: CRM · Revenue by Industry
sql:
SELECT a.industry,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.id)          AS account_count,
       COUNT(o.id)                   AS order_count,
       ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM accounts a
JOIN orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY a.industry
ORDER BY revenue DESC

name: CRM · Top 20 Accounts by Value
sql:
SELECT a.account_name, a.industry, a.segment, a.country,
       r.full_name                   AS account_owner,
       COUNT(o.id)                   AS order_count,
       ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS lifetime_value
FROM accounts a
JOIN orders o      ON o.account_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN sales_reps r ON r.id = a.owner_rep_id
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
GROUP BY a.id, a.account_name, a.industry, a.segment, a.country, r.full_name
ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC
LIMIT 20

name: CRM · Sales Rep Leaderboard
sql:
WITH won AS (
  SELECT owner_rep_id, SUM(amount) AS won_amount, COUNT(*) AS won_deals
  FROM opportunities WHERE is_won IS TRUE GROUP BY owner_rep_id
)
SELECT r.full_name, r.region, r.team,
       COALESCE(w.won_deals, 0)                AS won_deals,
       ROUND(COALESCE(w.won_amount, 0), 2)     AS won_amount,
       r.quota_annual,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(w.won_amount, 0) / NULLIF(r.quota_annual, 0), 1) AS quota_attainment_pct
FROM sales_reps r
LEFT JOIN won w ON w.owner_rep_id = r.id
WHERE r.is_active
ORDER BY won_amount DESC
LIMIT 25

name: CRM · Lead Funnel by Source
sql:
SELECT l.source,
       COUNT(*)                                                        AS lead_count,
       ROUND(AVG(l.score), 1)                                          AS avg_score,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Qualified')                  AS qualified,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Converted')                  AS converted,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Converted') / COUNT(*), 1) AS conversion_rate_pct
FROM leads l
GROUP BY l.source
ORDER BY lead_count DESC

name: CRM · Product Category Margin
sql:
SELECT p.category,
       SUM(oi.quantity)                                        AS units_sold,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2)                            AS revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2)                AS cost,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_margin,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(oi.line_total) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.line_total), 0), 1) AS margin_pct
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC

name: CRM · Support SLA by Priority
sql:
SELECT t.priority,
       COUNT(*)                                                     AS ticket_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL)            AS resolved_count,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.resolved_at - t.opened_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_resolution_hours,
       ROUND(AVG(t.satisfaction_score)::numeric, 2)                 AS avg_satisfaction
FROM support_tickets t
GROUP BY t.priority
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC

name: CRM · Campaign ROI
sql:
SELECT c.campaign_name, c.channel, c.target_segment,
       ROUND(c.budget, 2)                                    AS budget,
       COUNT(o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won IS TRUE)           AS won_opportunities,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won IS TRUE), 0), 2) AS influenced_revenue,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won IS TRUE), 0) / NULLIF(c.budget, 0), 2) AS roi_multiple
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.campaign_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.campaign_name, c.channel, c.target_segment, c.budget
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won IS TRUE), 0) > 0
ORDER BY roi_multiple DESC
LIMIT 25

name: CRM · Invoice Aging
sql:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN i.status = 'Paid' THEN '0 · Paid'
         WHEN CURRENT_DATE <= i.due_date THEN '1 · Not yet due'
         WHEN CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date <= 30 THEN '2 · 1-30 days'
         WHEN CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date <= 60 THEN '3 · 31-60 days'
         WHEN CURRENT_DATE - i.due_date <= 90 THEN '4 · 61-90 days'
         ELSE '5 · 90+ days'
       END                            AS aging_bucket,
       COUNT(*)                       AS invoice_count,
       ROUND(SUM(i.amount), 2)        AS outstanding_amount
FROM invoices i
WHERE i.status <> 'Void'
GROUP BY aging_bucket
ORDER BY aging_bucket
